title: To Multimedia File
text: Stream video frames and audio samples to multimedia file, 8 inputs, no direct feedthrough, {Audio data type} sets Audio data type 16-bit; {File name}, {File type}, {Write} sets the type of multimedia, {Audio Quality (0-100)} sets the quality of audio file, {Audio Bit Rate (kb/s)} sets the audio compressor, {Audio compressor}, {Video compressor}, {Compression Factor (>1)} sets the compression factor greater), {File color format}, {Image signal} and {Video Quality (0-100)} sets the quality of video. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Image
ports.summary: Color image or video frame array

ports.name: R
ports.summary: Red color component of image or video frame matrix

ports.name: G
ports.summary: Green color component of image or video frame matrix

ports.name: B
ports.summary: Blue color component of image or video frame matrix

ports.name: Y
ports.summary: Luma component of image or video frame matrix

ports.name: Cb
ports.summary: Blue-difference chrominance component of image or video frame matrix

ports.name: Cr
ports.summary: Red-difference chrominance component of image or video frame matrix

params.name: File type
params.values: File type of multimedia file WAV (default) | AVI MJ2000 | WMA | WMV | MPEG4 | FLAC | MP3 | OGG | OPUS

params.name: Write
params.values: Type of multimedia Audio only (default) | Video and audio | Video only

params.name: Audio Quality (0-100)
params.values: Quality of audio file 75 (default) | integer in range [0 100]

params.name: Audio data type
params.values: Audio data type 16-bit integer (default) | Determine from input data type | 8-bit integer | 24-bit integer | 32-bit integer | 32-bit float | 64-bit float

params.name: Image signal
params.values: Image signal Separate color signals (default) | One multidimensional signal

params.name: Video Quality (0-100)
params.values: Quality of video 75 (default) | integer in range [0 100]
